name: Reporting Settings Shell
summary: Single-card Reporting settings placeholder that explicitly communicates Reporting configuration is not implemented yet and no longer exposes the retired placeholder child pages from the old shell.

userActions: Open Reporting settings from the settings shell
See immediately that Reporting settings are not implemented yet
preserveRules: Keep Reporting settings clearly marked as a placeholder
Do not describe Reporting settings as persisted editors
Do not route users to the retired Reporting child pages
acceptanceCriteria: Reporting settings open a single placeholder experience
Metadata reflects that only the shell placeholder is active
Metadata does not imply hidden or still-routable Reporting child pages
validationHints: Confirm the settings shell opens the Reporting placeholder card
Confirm search destinations no longer advertise retired Reporting child pages
Confirm metadata does not overstate Reporting feature completeness
